mechanism: Keep EMA G of [x,1]^T[x,1]/B and EMA C of [x,1]^Ty/B. Use solve(G + 0.01 I, C) as the same 9-by-2 descriptor previously supplied as C. G and C start at zero and decay on every observed batch. The intercept is regularized along with other coefficients. All summaries, solves, student and optimizer state are float32. Raw controls retain the exact E21 post-outcome implementation. Ridge uses the same post-outcome memory assignment: predict from preceding descriptor, observe outputs, update G/C and solve, then train/store with the new descriptor. No true regime, family or boundary reaches the learner.
hypothesis: Input-normalized relationship evidence may reduce spurious context drift and conflicting replay. In full-rank noiseless linear data without ridge, coefficients are exactly invariant to input-distribution changes; regularization, observation noise, finite evidence and nonlinear teacher functions invalidate exact invariance. The scored tasks deliberately retain nonlinear functions. This is a descriptor-package intervention; coefficient scale and orientation change too, so it does not isolate covariance normalization from all encoding effects.
controls: Cross raw versus ridge descriptors with slow 0.95 and fast 0.5 decay on four new seeds and the unchanged five E22 families. All learners start with identical 738-parameter students and reservoir RNG, retain 512 examples, use the same Adam-shaped 0.01 updates and consume identical paired data. Raw post-outcome controls must exactly reproduce E21 class behavior in the preflight. No learned gate, offline training, model widening, true context or task-boundary reset is added.
preflight: Check unchanged raw controls at both decays, identical initial predictions, coefficient solution against normal equations, exact full-rank linear no-noise/no-ridge invariance under mean/covariance shifts, causal prediction before output, actual descriptor update, correct post-outcome replay annotations, exact resumed student/statistics/replay/RNG trajectory, finite solves and complete counters. Preflight seeds are disjoint from scored worlds. Preserve all failures. Freeze implementation and protocol before scored execution.
evaluation: Same E17 prequential clean/noisy errors, four quarters and all censored recovery segments. Preserve per-batch descriptor changes and norms plus alternating 512-batch phase errors. Union change segments shorter than the three-batch recovery criterion are counted and retained. Compare each descriptor at the same decay and all strong controls, not only the weak slow baseline. Scored means never choose ridge, decay or checkpoint.
costs: Each run gets 131072 observations, 4096 student updates and 393184 student forward examples. Ridge adds 4096 nine-by-nine matrix solves, 4096 Gram updates and 396 bytes of persistent G/C tensors over the existing context. Count all learner tensor storage and actual local loop time; inherited redundant context calculations also cost time. Preflight, generation and checkpoint serialization are separately identified. Full process RAM, peak solver workspace, complete FLOPs and energy are unmeasured. There are 80 new runs across twenty paired worlds, not eighty independent acquired datasets.
falsification: If regularized coefficients fail to improve the fixed model across nonlinear changing-dependency streams, do not install them as a universal context representation. A linear algebra preflight is not task success. A scoped gain cannot establish learned semantic compression, arbitrary context identity, general reasoning, reliable recursive self-improvement or a novel architecture. ALPaCA and ordinary adaptive regression are credited prior art. After this bounded diagnostic, prioritize the architecture's untested memory compression and ordered-reasoning claims instead of indefinite tuning of this assay.
